title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ACS funded project provided lifesaving emergency assistance to the most vulnerable coastal communities affected by storm and sea tidal surge on the West Coast of Yemen in Taiz Governorate. The project constructed and repaired 28 shelters, restoring the dignified living conditions of 28 HHs affected by sea tides in the Dubab district. The fishing communities in the Dubab district were supported with the repair and maintenance of the 16 boats affected by the sea tide, restoring the livelihoods of 16 HHs directly while also contributing to the fishing market and related vendors and business activities. . Marker 1.5 was selected because the primary objective was to provide emergency lifesaving assistant to IDPs affected by catastrophic sandstorm and to ensure improved living conditions by reconstructing their homes and livelihoods stronger than before to withstand climate related events.
